tc.research_text.ARCANEASSEMBLER: The arcane version of the ME Molecular Assembler, capable of automated arcane crafting.
tc.research_text.ARCANEASSEMBLER.stage.1: The Arcane Assembly Chamber is the arcane version of the ME Molecular Assembler. It can automatically execute arcane crafting recipes, perfectly merging magic with automation.
tc.research_text.ARCANEASSEMBLER.stage.2: Connect it to a network and the Arcane Assembler will do arcane crafts by itself, drawing vis from around it; put a Vis Relay Interface beside it and the network will pay instead. While it works, you can watch the finished item hanging in the middle of the block.
tc.research_text.ARCANECRAFTINGTERMINAL: Combine an ME Terminal with an Arcane Worktable for direct arcane crafting in the ME network.
By combining an ME Terminal with an Arcane Worktable, you can perform arcane crafting directly within the ME network.

Arcane crafts can be made in the terminal too: put the wand in the terminal's wand slot, take the ingredients from the network, and let the network cover the vis you are short of. It will work out the price before you craft.
tc.research_text.BASEENERGISTICS:
I have found a curiosity. Place an aspect-bearing crystal beside an AE device and the device responds - not to the crystal, but to the essentia inside it. The machinery cannot see magic, yet it can measure this. Whatever essentia is, part of it is regular enough for a machine to count. If I can teach the network to hold essentia the way it holds items, every jar and alembic in my laboratory becomes part of one store.
High-version textures drawn by @麦淇淋.
tc.research_text.CERTUS_DUPE: Using alchemical duplication, you can duplicate certus quartz crystals. This provides a renewable source of certus quartz for your AE network.
tc.research_text.DIGISENTIA: Digitize essentia using Diffusion and Coalescence Cores for processing by the ME network.
tc.research_text.DIGISENTIA.stage.1: Though essentia is a mystical substance, you have discovered it can be processed using AE's digital technology. The key lies in two cores: a Diffusion Core to decompose essentia into digital signals, and a Coalescence Core to reassemble digital signals back into essentia.
tc.research_text.DIGISENTIA.stage.2: You have successfully crafted the Diffusion Core and Coalescence Core. They will serve as the foundation of your entire Thaumic Energistics system.
tc.research_text.DISTILLATIONENCODER: It writes 'this item distils into this much of that aspect' as an ME processing pattern. An aspect the item does not already hold will never be written into one.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIABUSES: Essentia Import, Export, and Storage Buses bridge physical essentia containers with the ME network.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIABUSES.stage.1: Using Diffusion and Coalescence Cores, you can create three types of essentia buses: the Import Bus extracts essentia from external containers into the ME network, the Export Bus outputs essentia from the network into external containers, and the Storage Bus maps external containers as ME network storage units.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIABUSES.stage.2: Essentia buses are the bridge between the physical world and the digital essentia realm. Attach them to an ME cable facing an essentia container to activate them.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIACELLWORKBENCH.s: A cell that accepts anything will fill up with the first aspect that reaches it. I need a way to tell a cell which aspects it is allowed to hold before it ever enters the network.

The essentia cell workbench writes a partition onto a cell: place the cell in the top slot and drag aspects into the wells, and the network will refuse to store anything else in it. Clicking "partition to contents" fills the wells from what the cell already holds.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIALEVELEMITTER: A redstone signal that follows how much of one aspect the network holds. Set the aspect and a threshold, and the emitter lights while the network has less than that - or more, if I invert it. It is how a jar gets refilled before it runs dry without anything watching it.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAPROVIDER: Automatically extracts essentia from the ME network and supplies adjacent containers.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAPROVIDER.connec: The Wireless Essentia Receiver can be mounted on any surface. Use the Wireless Essentia Binding Tool to link it to an Essentia Provider, relaying essentia to alchemy towers and stills at a distance. Each provider serves up to eight receivers within thirty-two blocks; each additional receiver costs five extra AE/t. The receiver can also feed essentia back into the network, up to sixteen per transfer.
The Essentia Provider automatically extracts essentia from the ME network and supplies it to adjacent essentia containers. This is invaluable for devices that consume large amounts of essentia.
Place the Essentia Provider adjacent to an essentia container, and it will automatically replenish the container up to the configured level.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAPROVIDER.tool.s: The receiver bolts to any surface and carries essentia to a still or an alembic from wherever the provider is. The binding tool makes and breaks the link: sneak-right-click an unlinked receiver to select it, then sneak-right-click a provider to bind the two. A plain right-click on either end reports where it is and what it is bound to.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIASTORAGE: Using Coalescence Cores and wisp essences, you can create ME storage cells capable of storing essentia. Available in 1k, 4k, 16k, and 64k variants.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIASTORAGE16k.stag: The same trick again, now with engineering-grade circuitry in the binding. Sixteen times the capacity of a single component.
The 16k component is complete. Essentia density this high needs careful casing, but it holds.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIASTORAGE1k.stage: A storage cell is only as useful as the casing that holds its components. The schematics I found describe an ME storage component wound with essentia crystals - the same trick the Diffusion and Coalescence Cores use, applied at scale.
The 1k essentia storage component and its cell are complete. Eight thousand esssential units fit in a single cell, far more than any jar could hold, and the network reads it as ordinary storage.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIASTORAGE4k.stage: One component is not enough. By binding three 1k components into a single casing I should be able to hold four times as much.
The 4k component is stable and its cell holds four times the essentia of the 1k.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIASTORAGE64k.stag: The final tier. The calculations are considerably more demanding than the previous ones, and the casing must be flawless.
The 64k component is done - sixty-four times the capacity of a single component, and enough essentia to run a serious alchemical operation from the network alone.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIATERMINAL: View and manage all essentia stored in your ME network.
The Essentia Terminal allows you to view all essentia stored in your ME network, just like browsing items. You can insert and extract essentia directly from the terminal.
The Essentia Terminal can only view and manipulate essentia — it cannot access items or fluids. It is purpose-built for essentia management.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAVIBRATIONCHAMBE: Surplus essentia can be burned into AE power. Potentia lasts the longest, ignis a little less, and any other aspect gives you half as much.
tc.research_text.FOCUS_AEWRENCH: An AE wrench folded into a wand focus, so you no longer have to swap tools to take a device apart. Blocks and cable parts still want a sneak; a plain click will only turn them.
tc.research_text.GOLEMWIFI: Click a linked backpack onto your golem, and it will feed the odds and ends nobody asked it to carry into the network, as long as a wireless access point can see it. To take the pack off, sneak and ring the bell; to give it another colour, click it with a block.
tc.research_text.INFUSIONMONITOR.stage.1: To observe is to command. You place the Thaumonomicon beside the altar, an observer peering into each pulse of the infusion — the stirring of aura, the opening of rifts, the first whisper of flux. Bound to an ME network, the observer truly opens its eyes.
tc.research_text.INFUSIONMONITOR.stage.2: Set it beside an Infusion Altar, place the Thaumonomicon on it and connect it to the network, and the risk of the ritual will hang in the air above the altar. To take the tome back, sneak with an empty hand.
tc.research_text.INFUSIONPROVIDER: Automatically supplies essentia from the ME network to an Infusion Altar.
The Infusion Provider is an upgraded Essentia Provider. It can directly inject essentia from the ME network into an Infusion Altar, fully automating the infusion process.
Set it anywhere the altar can reach, usually underneath. The essentia the ritual needs will come straight from the network, and the jars can all go back in the chest.
tc.research_text.KNOWLEDGECORE: A core of crystallised knowledge. Written into it are the patterns of arcane crafting, stored in the compressed form an ME network can read - the same idea as a pattern, for a craft the network could never perform on its own.
tc.research_text.KNOWLEDGEINSCRIBER: The Knowledge Inscriber converts Thaumaturgical research notes into Knowledge Cores that the AE network can recognize. It bridges the gap between arcane knowledge and digital storage.
tc.research_text.KNOWLEDGEINSCRIBER.stag: I have been trying to teach this Knowledge Core how to craft, and it has learned nothing. Clearly there is a way to force the lesson in, and clearly it is not by talking to it.

Basing the design on an ME Pattern Terminal, I have built a machine that teaches recipes to a Knowledge Core: load the grid, press save, and the recipe is written. The same machine reads a core back and erases from it. A single core remembers a limited number of recipes, but cores are not hard to make.
tc.research_text.VISINTERFACE: Put one beside a machine that needs vis. Whenever the machine runs short, it will draw heavily on the ME network's power and turn it into vis for it.
tc.research_text.WIRELESSESSENTIATERMINA: Carrying a terminal to the jar is a waste of walking. The same wireless receiver an ME network already uses for its wireless terminal should carry essentia just as well.

The wireless essentia terminal links to a network through a wireless access point and shows its essentia from anywhere in range. Bind it to a network by using it, exactly as an ME wireless terminal is bound.
